policy: Same tier and rarity gear; zero potions, decline events, no equipment upgrades; steering RNG separate, initial combat seeds paired; observed EHP budget = MaxHP + actual healing + actual Barrier absorption, not a theoretical EHP formula.

draft.policy: Matched deterministic seeds, three early unlocked families; identical raw gear stats; all normal drafts through Realm14; random legal selections. Structural offers only, not win-rate simulation.

rank.policy: E50 Epic gear and three real E50 Runes; 0..3 extra same-family complementary talents besides mandatory starter; fixed durable enemy, boss at 3 companions. Native ticks, no formula overrides. Random/proc timing can be non-monotonic; compare effect parameters and unit assertions as well as aggregate damage. Dormant deterministic statistical talents do not have activation counters.
